summary: Unincorporated Jasper County community; a Gladesville lookout tower is listed under the Oconee National Forest, but no source gives its history or status.

evidence.supports: community is unincorporated, in Jasper County
evidence.quote: Gladesville is an unincorporated community in Jasper County

evidence.supports: named for a glade near the original town site
evidence.quote: The community was named for a glade near the original town site.
An old variant name is "The Glades"
A post office called Gladesville was established in 1853, and remained in operation until 1931.

evidence.supports: tower listed in Jasper County at 33.22040, -83.75490
Jasper County and Oconee National Forest for the tower

notes_for_editor: Only two lists name this tower (tnlandforms and Eastern US Lookouts). Two searches and about six page reads found no build date, height, builder, staffing, fire or status record. Blocked: anyplaceamerica topo page (403), Jasper County history page (empty), georgiaarchives Oconee NF survey record (403), rootsweb Jasper history (403). Lead for a human: the Oconee National Forest cultural survey (georgiaarchives HP900109-003) may describe lookouts. The Wikipedia community point (33.19389, -83.77833) is about 3.5 km from the tnlandforms tower point; the tower point is unverified. Story runs under the 120-word floor (110 words) because the sourced facts are few; not padded.
